speaker: en_a
text: Hello, my name is Linda. It is nice to meet you.

speaker: es_a
text: Hola, mi nombre es Linda. ¡Mucho gusto!

speaker: en_a
text: I am from Canada. I have lived in Volcan for five years.

speaker: es_a
text: Soy de Canadá. Tengo cinco años de vivir en Volcán.

speaker: en_a
text: I moved here in March.

speaker: es_a
text: Me mudé aquí en marzo.

speaker: en_a
text: January, February, March, April, May, June.

speaker: es_a
text: Enero, febrero, marzo, abril, mayo, junio.

speaker: en_a
text: July, August, September, October, November, December.

speaker: es_a
text: Julio, agosto, septiembre, octubre, noviembre, diciembre.

speaker: en_a
text: I have a few friends, and we like to play cards.

speaker: es_a
text: Tengo unos amigos y nos gusta jugar cartas.

speaker: en_a
text: I have a few friends, and we like to do yoga.

speaker: es_a
text: Tengo unos amigos y nos gusta hacer yoga.

speaker: en_a
text: My normal day starts at 7:00 a.m.

speaker: es_a
text: Mi día normal comienza a las 7:00 a.m.

speaker: en_a
text: I normally eat breakfast at home.

speaker: es_a
text: Normalmente desayuno en casa.

speaker: en_a
text: I normally eat breakfast at a restaurant.

speaker: es_a
text: Normalmente desayuno en un restaurante.

speaker: en_a
text: On Monday I went to the supermarket.

speaker: es_a
text: El lunes yo fui al supermercado.

speaker: en_a
text: On Monday I went to David.

speaker: es_a
text: El lunes yo fui a David.

speaker: en_a
text: On Monday I went to the river.

speaker: es_a
text: El lunes yo fui al río.

speaker: en_a
text: It was a nice day. In the morning it was dry but in the afternoon it rained.

speaker: es_a
text: Fue un día bonito. Por la mañana estuvo seco, pero por la tarde llovió.

speaker: en_a
text: Today, Tuesday, I will go for a haircut at 1:00 p.m.

speaker: es_a
text: Hoy martes voy a cortarme el pelo a la 1 de la tarde.

speaker: en_a
text: Tomorrow, Wednesday, I need to go to the dentist at 3:00 p.m. I don't like to go to the dentist, do you?

speaker: es_a
text: Mañana miércoles necesito ir al dentista a las 3:00 p.m. No me gusta ir al dentista, ¿y a ti?

speaker: en_a
text: Friday is the day I bring my things to recycling. They are open from 9:00 to noon.

speaker: es_a
text: El viernes es el día que llevo mis cosas al reciclaje. Abren de 9 a 12.

speaker: en_a
text: I bought fruit yesterday. The apples were $1.25 per pound. The watermelon was $3. The oranges were $2. The mangoes were 2 for $5.

speaker: es_a
text: Ayer compré fruta. Las manzanas costaban 1.25 dólares por libra. La sandía costaba tres dólares. Las naranjas dos dólares. Los mangos estaban a 2 por 5 dólares.
